new_candidate.name: Jan Groths sceneteppe Strekkomposisjon i broderi
new_candidate.object_location: Hovudscenen, Det Norske Teatret, Kristian IVs gate 8, Oslo
new_candidate.source_description: Approximately 200 square metres, 12 panels of dark brown-black cotton, white embroidered line, backlit; theatre reports about 9.5m high and 22m wide.
new_candidate.direct_place_link: Commissioned for opening of the existing 1985 building; sewn together in this theatre's foyer.

image_provenance.rights_notice: Theatre's public press-image guidance restricts image reuse to non-commercial coverage, and notes separate photographer and performers' rights. No verified reusable CC member-photo license for this specific curtain image.
image_provenance.date_caveat: Theatre article text contains an internally inconsistent reference to photographing the curtain in 2014 on the occasion of Jan Groth's death while it separately gives his death as 2022. Do not assign a verified image date from that caption.

new_candidate.object_policy_implications: Distinct from Madame de Sade costume and both other garments. Could satisfy independent physical candidate count if exact artwork photo can be locally used under appropriate license; not a canonical Object today.

supplementary_research_only.supports: Three paintings installed as permanent foyer exhibits on 31 May 2023, alongside existing Kirkegårdsgravere, with Kortspillere specifically named.
blockers: No verified per-painting reproduction image license
